title: console-lab & console-ui move to react-dom 19.3.0
summary: A dependency-only change: the two console packages that render React in a browser (apps/console-lab and packages/console-ui) bump react-dom from 18.3.1 to 19.3.0 while react itself stays pinned at 18.3.1. The lockfile follows: the react-dom@18.3.1 and scheduler@0.23.2 entries are dropped, react-dom@19.3.0 and scheduler@0.28.0 are added, and every peer-resolved snapshot that carried react-dom — react-aria-components, react-aria, and @testing-library/react — is re-resolved against the new renderer. No application source changes; the blast radius is the renderer/scheduler pair that every console surface and every console-ui test run sits on.

nodes.label: react-dom
nodes.subtitle: 18.3.1 to 19.3.0

nodes.label: react
nodes.subtitle: 18.3.1 (pinned)
nodes.summary: The core React runtime. Deliberately left at 18.3.1 in both manifests, so the change is a renderer-only move and the two packages now run react-dom 19 against react 18.

nodes.label: scheduler
nodes.subtitle: 0.23.2 to 0.28.0
nodes.summary: The scheduler react-dom delegates to. The 0.23.2 entry (which depended on loose-envify) is removed and 0.28.0 is added as a dependency of react-dom@19.3.0.

nodes.label: react-aria-components
nodes.subtitle: 1.21.1, re-resolved
nodes.summary: Accessible component layer used by the console UI. Its version is unchanged but its peer resolution is rewritten to react-dom@19.3.0, and it in turn re-resolves react-aria.

nodes.label: @testing-library/react
nodes.subtitle: 16.3.3, re-resolved
nodes.summary: The test renderer used by console-ui's jsdom suite. Its snapshot is re-resolved against react-dom@19.3.0, so the test path moves with the runtime path.

nodes.label: pnpm-lock.yaml
nodes.subtitle: lockfile
nodes.summary: Records the whole resolution: importer specifiers, the removed react-dom@18.3.1 / scheduler@0.23.2 package entries, the added react-dom@19.3.0 / scheduler@0.28.0 entries, and every rewritten peer snapshot.
